title: The Unexpected Guest
logline: The leader of the thieves returns as a smiling new merchant and gets himself invited to dinner at Ali Baba's house; Morgiana knows his ring and his voice, quietly sends for the guards, traps him in his own lies, and stops him at the courtyard gate with one polite sentence.
moral: A watchful, calm mind sees through a friendly mask; small details give a liar away.
tone: A dinner-table suspense comedy: warm, full, lamp-lit rooms, a too-friendly guest, and a heroine who fights with a smile, a teapot and five clues. Family-friendly, no weapons, no harm; 80s cel anime with wide views, pans across full sets and English speech balloons.

beats.summary: The leader of the thieves, disguised again, opens a small shop in the market.
The smile drops when no one looks: he is waiting for a way to Ali Baba's house.
He finds the way: Ali Baba's nephew, who works by the market.
Helped and given a gift, the nephew invites him to dinner with the family.
Morgiana sees the silver ring with the split blue stone: the escaped oil merchant's ring.
She hears his voice again; suspicion grows.
He asks to sit by the door and keeps measuring the way out.
Morgiana quietly sends the neighbours for the guards, and returns smiling.
He says he has never been here, then names the old lanes: caught lying.
Asked about an oil merchant, his voice breaks and he nearly drops his cup.
She knows he is the leader, and signals Ali Baba.
He spots the guards at the window and excuses himself.
He runs for the courtyard; her polite call stops him and he turns. To be continued.

subtitles.en: Morgiana visited the neighbors who had helped her before and asked them to alert the guards quietly.|She returned smiling, served the guest simple food, and began asking about his travels and friends.

subtitles.ar: قال إنه لم يزر البلدة من قبل، لكن مرجانة عرفت أنه يكذب حين سمّى الأزقة القديمة.|سألته عن تاجر الزيت، فتغير صوته وكاد يسقط كوبه.
subtitles.en: He claimed he had never visited town, but Morgiana knew he was lying when he named the old alleys.|She asked about an oil merchant; his voice changed, and he nearly dropped his cup.

subtitles.ar: عرفت مرجانة أنه القائد، وأشارت إلى علي بابا.|كان الحراس في الطريق، لكن الضيف لمحهم عند النافذة واعتذر عن العشاء.
subtitles.en: Morgiana recognized the leader and signaled Ali Baba.|Guards were on their way, but the guest spotted them at the window and excused himself.

subtitles.ar: اندفع الرجل نحو الفناء.|قالت مرجانة: «لحظة يا سيدي، نسيت هديتك!»|فتوقف والتفت إليها.
subtitles.en: The man rushed toward the courtyard.|“One moment, sir; you forgot your gift!” Morgiana called.|He stopped and turned.

new_assets.name: dinnerRoom
new_assets.description: Ali Baba's dinner room, a full warm interior strip 1600 x 1230 for episodes 5 and 6 and any family meal: street window, shelf niche, three hanging lamps, kitchen arch with bead curtain, courtyard door with a view, chest, low round table loaded with food, six cushions, patterned rugs. Exact coordinates in sets.dinnerRoom. Exports anchors DR = {floor, window, niche, lamps, arch, door, chest, table, seats: {ali, honour, wife, kid, nephew, guest}, rug}.
new_assets.implementation: abDinnerPlate() baked once with abBakeAt like abStreetPlate: wall and dado rectangles with abGrad warmth under each lamp, tiles as a row of celShade quads, niche as an inset darker rect with shelf lines, rug as a quad with a border and a repeated diamond row. Live over the plate: hangingLamp x3 with abGlow at a 12 fps flicker, bead curtain as 12 dotted ribbons on swing/idleSway, door curtain ribbon, window and door views = ctx.clip of the opening then drawImage of the street or courtyard night plate at 0.5 scale plus small live parts (helmets, lantern, jars). Table in two passes: stand and tray back edge before the three seated behind it (y 880), tray front edge and dishes after them; the people at the table ends (y 900) are drawn after the table. Dishes are separate cels (dinnerFood) with steam ribbons on a travelling sine.

new_assets.name: shopFront
new_assets.description: A small market shop booth 300 wide x 420 high (x 960..1260, counter top y 770, roof line y 480): two poles, a striped awning (coral and cream here) with field open 0..1 that unrolls and bounces, a counter 280 x 130 with a cloth front, two back shelves with brass lamps, trays and a coffee pot (backlit glow), and the hanging sign board (shopSign) with field swing. Fields: x, open, sign, pal, goods. Reusable for any trader; in episode 6 it becomes Morgiana's shop with a turquoise awning.
new_assets.implementation: Drawn live over the marketStreet strip: poles as seg, awning as a celShade quad whose lower edge is a 7 scallop polyline scaled by open (kfn with one overshoot), counter and shelves as celShade rects, goods as 6 to 8 point brass shapes with abGlint and a soft abGlow behind them. The corner post is redrawn as a front pass for the peek at 18.32.

new_assets.name: newMerchant and nephew (palette variants)
new_assets.description: abNewMerchant: the leader's proportions in the merchant costume with AB_NEWM0 (coral, cream sleeves, plum turban, hennaed short beard), fields fine (cloak, jewel, feather) and cuff (long sleeve end covering the hand and ring). abNephew: servant preset, s 0.94, age 0.08, AB_NEPH0 (white shirt, emerald waistcoat, saffron sash, rust skullcap). Both return in episode 6.
new_assets.implementation: pal overrides {robe, sleeve, sash, hc, band, beard} on person; the short beard = the beard polygon scaled 0.6 in y. cuff: after the person call draw a cream trapezoid 26 x 30 over each hand point from P.hands, alpha = cuff. fine: cloak as a 5 point ribbon from the shoulders with lagged sway and a gold edge line, feather as a 3 point ribbon two drawings late. Waistcoat for the nephew = two celShade panels over the tunic chest.

new_assets.name: cupFumble
new_assets.description: A small object slips from a hand, is batted up twice and caught: three parabolas (drop 60, bat to +160, bat to +110) with spin, liquid drops on their own falls, and both hands tracking the object as world targets so the body lurches after it. Here the tea glass at 104.04 to 105.56.
new_assets.implementation: A list of arcs [{t0, t1, from, to, apex}] evaluated with hop/fallY style parabolas; cup angle from arc progress; 5 tea drops (ell r 4) launched at the second bat on fallY with seeded offsets; hands = handLW/handRW set to the cup point lagged by one drawing; landSquash on the catch.

new_assets.name: voiceWave and clueCounter
new_assets.description: voiceWave(ctx, x, y, {shape, col, len, jag, p}): a speaker's voice drawn as a ribbon 220 x 40 with a fixed bump pattern (LEADER_WAVE = 7 bump heights), so two ribbons of different colours can be seen to match; jag 0..1 turns the bumps into spikes and breaks the ribbon. clueCounter: S.counter with the label CLUES in the top right corner of the panel, ticking 1 to 5 at 50.2, 57.4, 67.7, 98.1 and 105.9, each tick with a small pop of the number.
new_assets.implementation: Ribbon = polyline through the 7 bump heights with a travelling phase, stroked twice (dark outline, colour) and drawn on by p; the match at 55.0 slides ribbon B onto ribbon A with kfn and adds abGlint. Counter: S.counter(ctx, n, x, y, p) with S.label CLUES beside it; visible from 50.2 to 113.0 only.

new_assets.name: windowView and memoryPanel
new_assets.description: windowView: a clipped opening (window or door) showing another set plate at 0.5 scale with a few live parts behind the frame (guard helmets passing, lantern, jars). memoryPanel: a rounded cream-bordered inset or half panel showing a remembered picture from an earlier episode (the knocking fist, the oil merchant, the escape over the wall).
new_assets.implementation: ctx.save, clip the opening rect or arch (townArchPts), translate and scale 0.5, drawImage the baked plate, draw the live parts, restore, then the frame front pass. memoryPanel = clip a rounded rect, fill a paler copy of the plate, draw the cels, stroke a 10 wide cream border; no tint over the cels.

owner_questions: The film ends on TO BE CONTINUED... instead of THE END because episode 6 continues from the same moment (series decision); default: TO BE CONTINUED....

The leader's second disguise is a new design (coral robe, plum turban, short hennaed beard, long cuffs that hide his hands, a plum cloak with gold trim for dinner), clearly different from the oil merchant; default: this design.
The nephew (Cassim's son) is a new character: a cheerful beardless young man in a white shirt, emerald waistcoat and saffron sash (his father's colours); default: this design.
The audience is told who the merchant is at once, by a band of light that shows the leader inside it at 0.5 s and again at 109.5 s; default: included.

The gift of paragraph 2 is a small wrapped box that is never opened; the nephew leaves it on the chest in the dinner room and Morgiana holds that same box up at the end as her pretext (reading "your gift" as the gift he brought); default: the same box.
Addition for episode 6: on her way back from the neighbours Morgiana quietly bars the courtyard gate (79.4 s), so the gate he runs to is already shut; default: included.
Morgiana counts her evidence with an on-screen CLUES counter 1 to 5 (ring, voice, seat by the door, the lanes, the cup); default: included.

Invented English balloon and label lines: I AM A NEW MERCHANT!, THE NEPHEW, COME TO DINNER!, THE SAME RING!, WHAT A FINE HOME!, MAY I SIT BY THE DOOR?, TELL THE GUARDS. QUIETLY!, WHERE HAVE YOU TRAVELLED?, MY FIRST TIME IN THIS TOWN!, ...BY OLD WELL LANE, OF COURSE!, EVER MET AN OIL MERCHANT?, N-NO!, THE LEADER!, I MUST GO!, plus the two script lines ONE MOMENT, SIR! and YOU FORGOT YOUR GIFT!; default: kept as written.
The trusted neighbours are the old woman, the baker and his apprentice from the ALI-04 plan, and the apprentice is the one who runs for the guards; default: as described.

Comic additions beyond the script: the switch-on smile repeated for three customers, the thought bubble of five little thieves that he swats away, the captain's plume left above the window sill, the cat and donkey distrusting him; default: all included.
The guards are shown only as helmets (at the window, and rising behind the courtyard wall in the last picture); default: included, with no weapons in use.
implementation_notes: Copy ab_kit.js, ab_cast.js, ab_sets.js and the reusable parts of ab_main.js from Animations/ALI-01-ANIME/src/, ALI-02's additions (abCamClamp, tiptoeFreeze, strainLift, blush), ALI-03's (abMorgiana with windowBust and AB_FACE.morgiana, abOilMerchant, abStreetPlate with TS anchors and models, oilJar, silverRing, sneakChain, the market call with laneArch) and ALI-04's (abCourtPlate with CY anchors, gateBar, disguiseWipe, guards and captain, baker, youth, householdArms) into Animations/ALI-05/src/ under the same names and extend there. No palette of an existing character changes. If an earlier episode's drawing is not finished when this film is built, build it here from that episode's plan with the same names and numbers.

Frame order: S.background, S.box panel, plate, window and door views, live set parts (lamps, curtains, doors, shop), back-of-table cels, table, front cels, props, light (abGlow, abBands, rims), lettering and counter, transition, subtitle, S.finish last.

Pose every character at tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps) (12 fps); blinks, lip flaps and the balloon jitter at celStep(t, 8). Camera, glows, glints, the counter, the light band, the dotted route and the tape transition run on every frame.

Word cues with w(p, n) from timing.json; every cue time in this plan is a word start from inputs/timeline.md. Subtitle chunks are those of chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt, already timed in timing.json; use it unchanged.

SMILE is one flow key list (mouth, lid, tip, glint time) defined once and replayed at 9.40, 10.14, 10.76, 17.0, 18.9 and, at half speed, 131.82; the drop at 11.90 is one drawing. Morgiana gets her own softer list at 79.92 and 128.56. The repetition is the joke and the characterisation.

The ring is data: RING_SHOWN(t) true at 13.2-13.9, 34.3, 41.8-50.0, 105.5-106.6 and from 130.3; otherwise cuff = 1 covers the hand. Episode 6 opens with Morgiana pulling the sleeve back, so the cuff must be visibly down again at 133.

Seated people use person {sit: 1, seat: floor} at the cushion anchors; the three behind the table are drawn at y 880 before the table front pass. The guest standing up at 118.6 is sit 1 to 0 with anticipate and a stretch.

The Library person has no back or profile view. Morgiana passes behind the guest (he faces the viewer, she is upstage), the run in S16 is a frontal figure tipped forward with a fast walk, and the turn at 131.82 is eyes, blink, tip and weight shift, not a body rotation. Check these three on contact sheets.

Close-ups are only: the ring insert 42.2-46.9 (with the split memory panel to 50.0) and Morgiana's eyes 106.8-108.8. Everything else is wide or medium with the floor in the lower part of the picture; no framing above zoom 1.35 outside those two.

Balloons with abSay (S.label {balloon: true, to}) at size 50 to 52, the whisper at 46 with a thin outline, tails on the speaker's head, removed 0.4 s after the cue except MY FIRST TIME IN THIS TOWN!, which stays hanging until it is struck out at 95.68 and leaves at 98.5. Tags (THE NEPHEW, THE SAME RING!, THE LEADER!, CLUES) are plain labels at 40 or more. Pictograms (dish, helmet, ring, camel, ship, dune, heads, map, jar, question mark) are drawn shapes, not lettering.

Titles: S.title THE UNEXPECTED GUEST 0.3-3.0 with title_ar from story/script.json in Lalezar under it; S.title TO BE CONTINUED... from 133.5 to 137.82.
Sound (9, master 0.6, only in the listed pauses): pop 8.45, whoosh 17.7, glitch 35.0, chime 50.7, blip 69.0, pop 88.6, riser 106.6, whoosh 121.1, chime 133.7; tape bed under everything.

Evening and night: painted plates only, light and warm (nothing darker than #2a4a8a in a sky or #5a5a8a on a wall), AB_MODEL k = 0 (no tint over the cast). Warm rim castFinish {rim: #ffcf7a} for figures against lamp or door light; thin cool rim #bfe0ff for the guest at the gate. Sleeves stay a step lighter than robes; the guest's plum cloak must not swallow his arms (cream sleeves drawn over it).

Groups never in sync: stagger(i) and a seed per member for the townsfolk, the family at table (five different idle periods), the three neighbours and the guard helmets (sneakChain with the accordion bump at 114.7).

Moving holds in every pause: idleSway on tip and head, breathe on sq, scarf tail, cloak hem, feather, bead curtain, lamp flicker, steam, awnings, cat tail. groundShadow {flat: true} under every standing or running figure; cushions squash a little under sitters.
